structured.answer: Open an account at Pesagot (פסגות) and buy "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)". The page marks it as the cheapest and shows about 86,492 ₪ after 10 years. That's with the page's default amounts, 10,000 ₪ now plus 500 ₪ a month, not my 30,000.

stuck.why: Felt too low for 7% a year over 10 years (I expected about 70% more). I guessed the 'בכסף של היום' / אינפלציה note explains it but didn't open it
Left them at the defaults, so the final figure isn't for my own 30,000

findings.what: The headline result uses default amounts (10,000 + 500), so it's easy to walk away with a number that isn't yours
86,492 from 70,000 paid in looks far too low for 7% a year; the 'today's money' adjustment is only a small line
Red minus shekel amounts next to funds read like losses
A range like 'בין +2,212 ₪ ל־−23,766 ₪' is scary and unclear
Lots of jargon tags on every fund (צוברת, חשיפה לדולר, מס גם על שינוי המטבע)
Top pick is a non-bank house and a fund manager I barely know
